summary: Tested default observation and reflection templates feature. All 14 tests PASSED. The bootstrap_default_templates function correctly creates 2 observation templates (Training Template with 4 parts, Match Day Template with 2 parts) and 2 reflection templates (Coach Educator Reflection with 5 questions, Coach Reflection with 3 questions) for new accounts.

training_template_parts.details: Training Template has exactly 4 parts: Part 1, Part 2, Part 3, Part 4

match_day_template_parts.details: Match Day Template has exactly 2 parts: First Half, Second Half

coach_educator_reflection_questions.details: Coach Educator Reflection template has 5 questions with target_role='coach_educator'

coach_reflection_questions.details: Coach Reflection template has 3 questions with target_role='coach'

intervention_types.details: Both observation templates have intervention_types: Command, Q&A, Guided Discovery, Transmission

descriptor_groups.details: Both templates have descriptor_group1 (Content Focus: Technical, Tactical, Physical, Psych, Social) and descriptor_group2 (Delivery Method: Visual Demo, Triggers, Kinesthetic)
